event: A scraping sound occurs while a robot is standing by the light-gray two-seater couch and facing the light-colored refrigerator. Determine if the sounding object is to the robot's left, right, or back.

sounding_object.description: A dark-colored, circular frying pan, approximately 10-12 inches (25-30 cm) in diameter, with a long handle. During the specified event, it is located in the kitchen sink on the central island and is being scraped clean by a man.

reference_object.description: A modern, light-gray fabric two-seater couch located in the living room area. It has a white throw/blanket with the word 'NOBODY' printed in black draped over its back.

facing_object.description: A tall, built-in refrigerator with light-colored (appears metallic/reflective, possibly stainless steel or light gray) front panels. It is located in the kitchen area, to the right of the main kitchen counter and stovetop from the initial camera view. It has a visible water/ice dispenser.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray two-seater couch and facing the light-colored refrigerator, when the scraping sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
